K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills.context_zh: 在终端执行官方 npx 安装器，选择技能与宿主；安装技能文件不等于安装科学计算依赖。
K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills.context_en: Run the official npx installer in a terminal; choose skills and host. Skill files do not install scientific dependencies.

Imbad0202/academic-research-skills.context_zh: 在 Claude Code 会话内依次执行；新安装用 /ars-plan 或 /ars-lit-review 检查。
Imbad0202/academic-research-skills.context_en: Run both slash commands inside Claude Code; check discovery with /ars-plan or /ars-lit-review.

Yuan1z0825/nature-skills.context_zh: 在终端为当前项目 Codex 仅安装 nature-figure；reader/paper2ppt/polishing/writing 等技能需同时保留 nature-shared。
Yuan1z0825/nature-skills.context_en: Run in a terminal to install only nature-figure for Codex in the current project; reader/paper2ppt/polishing/writing also need nature-shared.
Yuan1z0825/nature-skills.command: npx skills add Yuan1z0825/nature-skills --agent codex --skill nature-figure --yes --copy

zsyggg/paper-craft-skills.context_zh: 终端执行官方npx命令，按目标宿主加载；亦可把官方安装提示词交给Codex或Claude Code处理克隆、链接和注册。
zsyggg/paper-craft-skills.context_en: Run the documented npx command in a terminal for the selected host; alternatively give the official installation prompt to Codex/Claude Code for cloning, linking and registration.

openags/paper-search-mcp.context_zh: 在终端安装CLI和Claude Code用户级Skill；下一次启动Claude Code生效，无需配置MCP。
openags/paper-search-mcp.context_en: Install the CLI and user-level Claude Code skill in a terminal; activates on next Claude Code start without MCP configuration.
openags/paper-search-mcp.command:
uv tool install paper-search-mcp
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills/paper-search
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openags/paper-search-mcp/main/claude-code/SKILL.md \
  -o ~/.claude/skills/paper-search/SKILL.md

wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-.context_zh: 在终端执行；将 ~/your-project 换成目标项目目录，安装器逐技能链接到项目 .claude/skills/。评审桥接和模型认证另按 README 配置。
wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-.context_en: Run in a terminal, replacing ~/your-project with the target project. Installer links skills into .claude/skills/. Configure reviewer bridge and model authentication separately.

Orchestra-Research/AI-Research-SKILLs.context_zh: 在终端执行交互安装器，按提示选择技能及宿主；安装器写入 ~/.orchestra/skills/ 并向宿主建立链接，Windows 可回退复制。
Orchestra-Research/AI-Research-SKILLs.context_en: Run the interactive terminal installer, choosing skills and hosts. It installs to ~/.orchestra/skills/ and links to hosts, falling back to copies on Windows.

Imbad0202/academic-research-skills-codex.context_zh: 在终端用 Codex CLI 安装插件；打开新 Codex 对话后调用 $academic-research-suite，并用 /skills 确认只有单一套件入口。
Imbad0202/academic-research-skills-codex.context_en: Install with Codex CLI in a terminal, open a new Codex conversation, invoke $academic-research-suite and verify the single suite entry with /skills.
Imbad0202/academic-research-skills-codex.command:
codex plugin marketplace add Imbad0202/academic-research-skills-codex --ref main
codex plugin add ars-codex@ars-codex

HKUSTDial/Supervisor-Skills.context_zh: 官方 Quick Start 是把安装请求发给 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex；这是一段给 Agent 的提示词，未提供可核验的终端安装命令。也可复制具体 SKILL.md 提示词使用。
HKUSTDial/Supervisor-Skills.context_en: Official Quick Start asks users to send an installation request to Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. This is an agent prompt, not a documented terminal installation command; individual SKILL.md prompts can also be copied.

hoochanlon/hamuleite.context_zh: 这是学术、教育与金融资源导航库；按目录浏览资料或所链接工具，未提供统一技能包安装步骤。
hoochanlon/hamuleite.context_en: This is a directory of academic, educational and financial resources; browse its folders and linked tools. No unified skill-package installation is documented.

ChenLiu-1996/figures4papers.context_zh: 在已获取的仓库根目录终端执行，为 Claude Code 建立用户级技能链接，然后重启或刷新技能列表；README 另给 Cursor 与 Codex 对应链接目录，亦可零安装按路径引用。
ChenLiu-1996/figures4papers.context_en: Run from the checked-out repository root to link the user-level Claude Code skill, then restart or refresh. README also gives Cursor/Codex link directories and a no-install path-based route.

Master-cai/Research-Paper-Writing-Skills.context_zh: 在已获取的仓库根目录终端执行；须先将 CODEX_HOME 设置为当前 Codex 配置根目录。README 另提供 Claude Code 与 Gemini 的复制目录。
Master-cai/Research-Paper-Writing-Skills.context_en: Run from the repository root with CODEX_HOME set to the Codex configuration root. README separately supplies Claude Code and Gemini copy destinations.

jihe520/MathModelAgent.context_zh: 在终端安装全部 Skills，再在 Claude Code 或 Codex 中调用对应启动技能；桌面版和旧 Web 后端部署是独立路线。
jihe520/MathModelAgent.context_en: Install all skills in a terminal, then invoke the start skill in Claude Code or Codex. Desktop and legacy web-backend deployments are separate routes.

zLanqing/codex-claude-academic-skills.context_zh: 官方说明手动把 research-writing-skill、office-academic-skill、scientific-toolkit-skill 目录放入 Claude Code 或 Codex 的全局/项目 skills 目录。README 的 clone/plugin 示例仍含“你的用户名”占位符，不提供伪造的一键命令。
zLanqing/codex-claude-academic-skills.context_en: Manually place research-writing-skill, office-academic-skill and scientific-toolkit-skill in Claude Code or Codex global/project skills directories. Clone/plugin examples contain an unreplaced username placeholder, so no fabricated one-line command is supplied.

brycewang-stanford/Auto-Empirical-Resear.context_zh: 在终端执行，安装 AER 稿件全流程插件（9 skills），并非一次安装合集内全部子技能。完整仓库按官方 INSTALL.md 的路由 Skill 方式另装。
brycewang-stanford/Auto-Empirical-Resear.context_en: Run in a terminal to install the AER manuscript lifecycle plugin (9 skills), not every child skill in the collection. Whole-repository routing is a separate INSTALL.md route.
brycewang-stanford/Auto-Empirical-Resear.command:
claude plugin marketplace add brycewang-stanford/Auto-Empirical-Research-Skills
claude plugin install aer-skills@auto-empirical-research-skills

Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skil.context_zh: 先获取仓库并在仓库根目录终端执行，复制中文版 Skill 到 Claude Code 的技能目录；英文版另复制 anti-defensive-writing-en。README 也允许把精简提示词直接粘贴到对话。
Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skil.context_en: From a local checkout root, copy the Chinese skill into Claude Code skills. The English skill uses anti-defensive-writing-en. README also supports copying the short prompt into a conversation.

Norman-bury/research-writing-skill.context_zh: 在终端执行 Codex 官方仓库安装文档所给 clone + 链接路线；重启 Codex 并检查链接。Windows 按同文档改用 PowerShell 目录连接；OpenCode 另按其安装文档配置插件。
Norman-bury/research-writing-skill.context_en: Run the repository documented Codex clone/link route in a terminal, then restart Codex and inspect the link. Windows uses the documented PowerShell junction alternative. OpenCode has a separate plugin configuration.

yilewang/llm-for-zotero.context_zh: 从官方 Releases 下载 .xpi，在 Zotero 的 Tools → Add-ons → Install Add-on From File 中安装，重启并在首选项配置模型供应商及连接测试。按所选后端完成额外配置。
yilewang/llm-for-zotero.context_en: Download the .xpi from official Releases, install through Zotero Tools → Add-ons → Install Add-on From File, restart, then configure and test a provider in preferences. Complete the additional setup for the chosen backend.

OpenNSWM-Lab/FAROS.context_zh: 按快速开始分别在 backend 和 frontend 安装并启动服务，再在设置页配置和测试模型。运行生成代码、计算节点部署、论文编译需继续完成部署指南相应依赖。
OpenNSWM-Lab/FAROS.context_en: Follow Quick Start to install/start backend and frontend separately, then configure and test a model in settings. Generated-code execution, compute-node deployment and paper compilation require the corresponding deployment-guide setup.

huangwb8/ChineseResearchLaTeX.context_zh: 在macOS/Linux/WSL终端运行官方Python引导器；默认同时安装general、research和anthropic-docs三个源到Claude/Codex用户目录，不仅是本仓库。按文档参数可限定source和宿主。
huangwb8/ChineseResearchLaTeX.context_en: Run the official Python bootstrapper in a macOS/Linux/WSL terminal; defaults install general, research and anthropic-docs sources into Claude/Codex user directories, not only this repository. Follow documented options to restrict source and host.

LigphiDonk/academic-figure-generator.context_zh: 在终端安装独立academic-figure-prompt Skill，按目标宿主加载；无需部署完整Web平台。
LigphiDonk/academic-figure-generator.context_en: Install the standalone academic-figure-prompt skill in a terminal and load in the selected host; full web-platform deployment is unnecessary.

dwzhu-pku/PaperBanana.context_zh: 在已安装 ClawHub CLI 的终端执行官方发布记录中的 Skill 安装命令；本地完整 PaperBanana 应用的 Python 环境安装另见 Quick Start。
dwzhu-pku/PaperBanana.context_en: Run the official release-note skill command in a terminal with ClawHub CLI available. Full local PaperBanana application setup is separately described in Quick Start.

alchaincyf/darwin-skill.context_zh: 在终端执行官方命令；安装后在支持 Skill 的 Agent 中发起优化。README 另给下载 ZIP 并将 SKILL.md 放入 ~/.claude/skills/darwin-skill/ 的路线。
alchaincyf/darwin-skill.context_en: Run the official command in a terminal, then request optimization in a skill-capable agent. README also documents ZIP/manual installation to ~/.claude/skills/darwin-skill/.

ScrapeCreators/social-media-research-ski.context_zh: 在终端执行，然后在运行宿主的环境中设置 SCRAPECREATORS_API_KEY。
ScrapeCreators/social-media-research-ski.context_en: Run in a terminal and set SCRAPECREATORS_API_KEY in the host process environment.

WUBING2023/PaperSpine.context_zh: 先下载官方 V6 ZIP 与 checksums.sha256 并解压；在解压目录终端运行，将占位符换成原 ZIP 路径和完整校验值。默认装到当前 Codex 用户 skills，其他宿主需指定 --skills-root。
WUBING2023/PaperSpine.context_en: Download official V6 ZIP and checksums.sha256, extract it and run from that directory. Replace placeholders with the ZIP path and full checksum. Defaults to current Codex user skills; other hosts require --skills-root.

AIScientists-Dev/academic-humanizer.context_zh: 在终端克隆到用户级 Claude Code 技能目录；Codex/MorphMind 可直接指向 SKILL.md 作为 Skill 或 system prompt，未给专用复制命令。
AIScientists-Dev/academic-humanizer.context_en: Clone in a terminal into user-level Claude Code skills. Codex/MorphMind may point directly at SKILL.md as a skill or system prompt; no dedicated copy command is provided.

MLNLP-World/Paper-Writing-Tips.context_zh: 在已获取的当前仓库根目录终端执行，解压打包 Skill 到项目 .claude/skills，然后重新打开 Claude Code。
MLNLP-World/Paper-Writing-Tips.context_en: Run from the local repository root to extract the packaged skill into project .claude/skills, then reopen Claude Code.

synthetic-sciences/openscience.context_zh: 在终端安装并启动 OpenScience 工作台；打开 Customize → Models 配置模型提供方，或使用 openscience keys add / openscience local add。这是独立应用安装而非其他 Agent 的 Skill 导入。
synthetic-sciences/openscience.context_en: Install and launch OpenScience from a terminal; connect a provider in Customize → Models or via openscience keys add / openscience local add. This installs a standalone workbench rather than importing a skill into another agent.

jmiao24/Paper2Agent.context_zh: 在终端按 Claude Code 路线复制整个 Skill 文件夹，包含支持文件；在研究工作区开启 Agent，若未发现技能则重启。Codex 另用 ~/.agents/skills/paper2agent。
jmiao24/Paper2Agent.context_en: Use the terminal Claude Code route to copy the entire skill including supporting files. Start the host in the analysis workspace and restart if undiscovered. Codex uses ~/.agents/skills/paper2agent instead.
jmiao24/Paper2Agent.command:
git clone https://github.com/jmiao24/Paper2Agent.git
cd Paper2Agent
mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/skills/paper2agent"
cp -R skills/paper2agent/. "$HOME/.claude/skills/paper2agent/"

google-deepmind/science-skills.context_zh: 在终端执行官方 README 的 npx 安装命令，按安装器选择宿主；Antigravity 仍可在应用 Customizations → Build with Google → Science → Add 手动启用。
google-deepmind/science-skills.context_en: Run the official README npx command in a terminal and choose the host in the installer. Antigravity also supports Customizations → Build with Google → Science → Add.

blazickjp/arxiv-mcp-server.context_zh: 在终端走 Claude Code 插件路线，同时安装 MCP 连接与 arXiv research Skill；重启或 /reload-plugins。若只需 MCP 服务，官方默认 uvx arxiv-mcp-server，不能改成同名 npm 包。
blazickjp/arxiv-mcp-server.context_en: Run the Claude Code plugin route in a terminal to install both MCP connection and arXiv research skill, then restart or /reload-plugins. For MCP-only use the official uvx arxiv-mcp-server route, not the unrelated npm package.
blazickjp/arxiv-mcp-server.command:
claude plugin marketplace add blazickjp/arxiv-mcp-server
claude plugin install arxiv-mcp-server@arxiv-mcp

FreedomIntelligence/OpenClaw-Medical-Ski.context_zh: 在终端按 OpenClaw 推荐 clone + copy 路线执行；将 <your-workspace> 换成已存在的 OpenClaw 工作区，复制到其 skills/。全局路线改为 ~/.openclaw/skills/，下个会话发现。
FreedomIntelligence/OpenClaw-Medical-Ski.context_en: Follow the recommended OpenClaw clone/copy route in a terminal. Replace <your-workspace> with an existing workspace and copy into its skills/. Global alternative uses ~/.openclaw/skills/; discovered next session.
FreedomIntelligence/OpenClaw-Medical-Ski.command:
git clone --depth=1 --no-checkout https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/OpenClaw-Medical-Skills.git
cd OpenClaw-Medical-Skills
git sparse-checkout init --cone
git sparse-checkout set skills
git checkout main
cp -r skills/* <your-workspace>/skills/

yb2460/harness-anything.context_zh: README给出WPS及Adobe子工具安装命令，但未注明Zotero学术Skill集的完整安装方式；按官方文档继续核对，不将WPS安装当Skill安装。
yb2460/harness-anything.context_en: README documents WPS and Adobe subtool installation, but not complete installation of its Zotero academic skill collection; consult the documentation.

EvoMap/AutoResearch.context_zh: 在Linux或SSH主机终端执行；安装仓库科研工作流，再按README配置.env和providers.local.json；不是Agent Skill目录安装。
EvoMap/AutoResearch.context_en: Run in a terminal on a Linux or SSH machine; install the research workflow, then configure .env and providers.local.json as documented; this is not skill-directory installation.
EvoMap/AutoResearch.command:
git clone https://github.com/EvoMap/AutoResearch.git
cd AutoResearch
bash scripts/bringup.sh

dw-dengwei/daily-arXiv-ai-enhanced.context_zh: 官方README提供已部署的GitHub Pages网页，明确无需安装；未给本地Skill安装步骤。
dw-dengwei/daily-arXiv-ai-enhanced.context_en: README links a deployed GitHub Pages site and explicitly says no installation is required; no local skill installation steps.

Haojae/scipilot-figure-skill.context_zh: 终端执行官方手动安装命令至Claude Code用户级目录；README亦声明Codex/Cursor兼容，但本命令不安装到其目录。
Haojae/scipilot-figure-skill.context_en: Run the documented manual installation commands in a terminal for user-level Claude Code; README also declares Codex/Cursor support, but this command does not target their directories.

wxyhgk/retain-pdf.context_zh: 在终端部署RetainPDF应用，启动后通过浏览器访问；这是应用部署，不是Skill安装。
wxyhgk/retain-pdf.context_en: Deploy the RetainPDF application in a terminal and access it in a browser; this is application deployment, not skill installation.
wxyhgk/retain-pdf.command:
git clone https://github.com/wxyhgk/retain-pdf.git
cd retain-pdf/ops/deployment/docker/delivery
docker compose up -d

HughYau/AcademicForge.context_zh: 在macOS/Linux项目根目录终端执行；示例仅选humanizer、superpowers并面向Claude；也可用选配站为Codex/OpenCode生成目标命令，Windows另有PowerShell脚本。
HughYau/AcademicForge.context_en: Run in a terminal at the project root on macOS/Linux; example selects only humanizer and superpowers for Claude. The selection site generates Codex/OpenCode alternatives; Windows has a PowerShell script.

Weizhena/Deep-Research-skills.context_zh: 终端执行Claude Code英文版手动路线；先确保宿主skills和agents目录存在；中文可换research-zh。Codex/OpenCode另有配置步骤。
Weizhena/Deep-Research-skills.context_en: Run the English Claude Code manual route in a terminal, ensuring host skills/agents directories exist; use research-zh for Chinese. Codex/OpenCode need their separate documented configuration.
Weizhena/Deep-Research-skills.command:
git clone https://github.com/Weizhena/deep-research-skills.git
cd deep-research-skills
cp -r skills/research-en/* ~/.claude/skills/
cp agents/web-search-agent.md ~/.claude/agents/
cp -r agents/web-search-modules ~/.claude/agents/
pip install pyyaml

poco-ai/Agentero.context_zh: macOS终端通过Homebrew安装桌面应用；Windows/Linux从官方Releases下载；应用中可接入Agent和社区Skill，不等同独立Skill安装。
poco-ai/Agentero.context_en: Install the desktop application with Homebrew in a macOS terminal; Windows/Linux use official Releases. The application connects agents/community skills; this is not standalone skill installation.
poco-ai/Agentero.command:
brew tap poco-ai/agentero
brew install --cask agentero

llmsresearch/paperbanana.context_zh: 终端克隆并安装官方源码路线，再从该仓库使用Claude Code；官方说明仓库内.claude/skills自动可用。Cursor走另列MCP配置路线。
llmsresearch/paperbanana.context_en: Clone and install the documented source route in a terminal, then use Claude Code in the repository; its .claude/skills are automatically available. Cursor uses the separately documented MCP configuration.
llmsresearch/paperbanana.command:
git clone https://github.com/llmsresearch/paperbanana.git
cd paperbanana
pip install -e ".[dev,openai,google]"

tsingyuai/scientify.context_zh: README仅指引前往Scientify.tech注册或登录并输入研究目标；没有可核验的本地Skill安装命令。
tsingyuai/scientify.context_en: README directs users to register/sign in at Scientify.tech and enter a research goal; no verifiable local skill installation command.

aipoch/medical-research-skills.context_zh: 官方明确先下载所选完整技能目录或git clone，再按Claude Code/Codex等宿主文档添加整个文件夹；未给统一目标路径或一键命令。
aipoch/medical-research-skills.context_en: Download a selected complete skill folder or clone the repository, then add the full folder following Claude Code/Codex host instructions; no universal destination or one-command install documented.

Kiterlin/anti-defensive-writing.context_zh: macOS/Linux/WSL终端执行，安装到Codex用户级.agents/skills；Claude Code改用文档对应dest，Windows使用PowerShell 7路线。
Kiterlin/anti-defensive-writing.context_en: Run in a macOS/Linux/WSL terminal for user-level Codex .agents/skills; use the documented destination for Claude Code or PowerShell 7 on Windows.

XiaoMaColtAI/math-modeling-skill.context_zh: 终端使用官方npx命令安装math-modeling；按所用Agent加载；dsh预设是另一个需要复制目录的安装路线。
XiaoMaColtAI/math-modeling-skill.context_en: Install math-modeling using the documented npx command in a terminal and load it in the selected agent; dsh presets use a separate folder-copy route.

juliye2025/evil-read-arxiv.context_zh: macOS/Linux终端从已下载仓库的父目录执行官方Codex手动复制命令；另在仓库根目录pip install -r requirements.txt并配置Vault路径和研究兴趣；新建或重启Codex会话。
juliye2025/evil-read-arxiv.context_en: Run the official Codex copy commands in a macOS/Linux terminal from the downloaded repository's parent directory; separately install requirements.txt at repository root and configure the vault/research interests; open a new/restarted Codex session.

mims-harvard/ToolUniverse.context_zh: 在终端执行Claude Code CLI插件命令；README另给npx技能和MCP客户端配置路线。
mims-harvard/ToolUniverse.context_en: Run the Claude Code CLI plugin commands in a terminal; README also documents npx skill and MCP-client configuration routes.
mims-harvard/ToolUniverse.command:
claude plugin marketplace add mims-harvard/ToolUniverse
claude plugin install tooluniverse@tooluniverse

pedrohcgs/claude-code-my-workflow.context_zh: 官方要求先在GitHub Fork或用模板创建自己的仓库，再克隆至my-project，运行./scripts/validate-setup.sh，进入该项目启动claude并粘贴官方starter prompt；不是安装一个独立Skill。
pedrohcgs/claude-code-my-workflow.context_en: Fork or use the GitHub template to create your repository, clone to my-project, run ./scripts/validate-setup.sh, then start claude in the project and use the official starter prompt; this sets up a project workflow rather than one standalone skill.

PaperDebugger/paperdebugger.context_zh: 按官方README从Chrome Web Store安装PaperDebugger浏览器扩展，打开Overleaf项目并点击图标；这是扩展安装，未给独立Skill安装方式。
PaperDebugger/paperdebugger.context_en: Install the PaperDebugger browser extension from the Chrome Web Store, open an Overleaf project and click its icon; this is extension installation, with no standalone skill install documented.

lishix520/academic-paper-skills.context_zh: 先下载实际仓库，在仓库根目录终端执行两条官方复制命令，确保目标skills目录存在，再重启Claude Code。README克隆示例仍为yourusername占位符，不提供该错误URL为可执行命令。
lishix520/academic-paper-skills.context_en: Download the actual repository, run both documented copy commands from its root with the skills destination present, then restart Claude Code. README clone example retains a yourusername placeholder; it is not presented as an executable repository URL.

brycewang-stanford/Awesome-Journal-Skill.context_zh: 在Claude Code会话中依次执行；示例只安装QJE pack，其他期刊需替换官方catalog中的pack名称。
brycewang-stanford/Awesome-Journal-Skill.context_en: Run sequentially inside a Claude Code session; example installs only the QJE pack; select other documented pack names from the catalog.

917Dhj/DeepPaperNote.context_zh: 终端执行Claude Code CLI命令安装全部四个Skill，再在实际使用的Python环境安装PyMuPDF；Codex等另可npx skills add 917Dhj/DeepPaperNote选择安装。
917Dhj/DeepPaperNote.context_en: Use the Claude Code CLI in a terminal to install all four skills, then install PyMuPDF in the runtime Python environment. Codex/other agents can instead select skills with npx skills add 917Dhj/DeepPaperNote.
917Dhj/DeepPaperNote.command:
claude plugin marketplace add 917Dhj/DeepPaperNote
claude plugin install deeppapernote@deeppapernote
python3 -m pip install PyMuPDF

huangkiki/dailypaper-skills.context_zh: 在终端安装完整七个技能和共享依赖到Codex目标；随后运行python3 skills/_shared/user_config.py --init，设置研究方向及保存位置并刷新会话。
huangkiki/dailypaper-skills.context_en: Install all seven skills and shared dependencies to the Codex target in a terminal; then run python3 skills/_shared/user_config.py --init, configure interests/output location and refresh the session.
huangkiki/dailypaper-skills.command:
git clone https://github.com/huangkiki/dailypaper-skills.git
cd dailypaper-skills
python3 install.py --agent codex
